title: Cloudflare launched self-managed OAuth for all
summary: Cloudflare has launched a self-managed OAuth solution available to all users, enabling developers to implement secure authentication without building their own OAuth infrastructure from scratch.
problem_solved: Simplifies the complex process of implementing secure OAuth authentication for developers who don't want to build and maintain their own identity infrastructure.
why_valuable: Provides enterprise-grade authentication capabilities to developers of all levels through Cloudflare's global network, reducing complexity and maintenance overhead.
